confidence.note: Raise it with real TikTok CPC/CVR from a $150 test and CJ landed-cost quotes for 3 SKUs.

gross_margin.note: 44% contribution before ads on a $34.99 order (estimate); under 50% is a costs_eat_margin hit (R5).

ltv_cac.note: LTV $18.45 vs CAC $57 on TikTok = 0.32; even a $0.50 CPC and 3% conversion only reaches 1.1.

pricing_power.note: Same AliExpress/CJ items sit on Amazon Haul and Temu at low prices; no reason to pay a premium.

build_effort.note: Shopify store plus CJ import is a few days of no-code work.

skills_match.note: Needs paid-social media buying and video creative; user has neither, learnable but costly.

capital_needed.note: $1,500 covers the store, but one product test at $300-600 of ads burns it in 3-5 tests.

time_to_mvp.note: Store and first ad live within 1-2 weeks.

sales_cycle.note: Impulse purchase straight from a TikTok ad.

channel_readiness.note: No audience; paid TikTok only, at a CAC above first-order profit (R5: no_distribution).

search_demand.note: 95M US pet households and $158B spend in 2025 (APPA).

trend.note: Pet spend +3.7% in 2025; TikTok Shop pet care +60%, but 'dropshipping' interest fell to 52 from 100.

willingness_to_pay.note: Chewy earns $595 per active customer a year: owners pay, but to incumbents.

free_alternatives.note: No free product, but the same items are a click away on Amazon, Temu and TikTok Shop.

competitor_density.note: 30,119 live Shopify pet stores, 46.5% US (Store Leads, 2025-03). R3/R5 cap.

differentiation.note: Generic sourced products, no edge stated (R3 cap).

legal_regulatory.note: Section 122 tariff, de minimis gone, FTC Mail Order Rule on shipping claims.

platform_dependency.note: One ad platform; TikTok flags dropship creatives and can suspend the account.

market_risk.note: Pet need is durable, but each winning product is a short-lived TikTok trend.

skills.note: No stated ecommerce, ads or creative track record.

assets.note: No audience, data, supplier or brand.

interest.note: Goal stated as side income, no stated pet passion.

sam.reasoning: Supplies, live animals and OTC medicine, US 2025

price.reasoning: typical impulse pet gadget price point; established pet stores average about $85 AOV (Webtonic), new dropship stores sell single items

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: CJ US-warehouse product + shipping incl. 10% Section 122 tariff $15.50 + Shopify Payments 2.9%+$0.30 = $1.31 + refunds/returns 8% of price $2.80

expected_lifetime.reasoning: one-off impulse buys; no autoship, no brand; assumed 20% buy a second item

conversion_rate_pct.reasoning: Shopify average 1.2-1.8% (Red Stag, Nudgify); cold TikTok traffic to a new store assumed at the average

ltv_cac.reasoning: 18.45 / 57.14; break-even ROAS is 2.28 vs Triple Whale median ROAS 2.04

payback_months.reasoning: each first order loses CAC 57.14 - contribution 15.38 = $41.76; repeat rate too low to recover

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: Shopify Basic $39 + apps (reviews, upsell) about $30 + domain $1

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: contribution after ads is negative at CAC 57.14; at zero CAC (organic) 70 / 15.38 = 5 orders/month

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: 1 week to build store and creatives + first ad sales in week 2 if any convert

launch_reason: Stated by the user; largest pet market ($158B) and TikTok's largest ad market.

rules_applied.effect: total 53 capped at 49: LTV:CAC 0.32 and paid TikTok costs more than a customer brings
Profit potential 1.50 (2 or less): 53 - 10 = 43, capped at 49 -> 43 (was 49)

cheapest_test: 7 days on a new pet TikTok account, 2 videos/day reviewing pet products, $0 spent: proves whether you can earn attention before paying for it.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 300 followers and no video above 5,000 views by day 7 -> stop
Fewer than 2,000 followers by day 30 -> archive the idea
If you still test the store: CPA above $15.38 after $150 of TikTok spend by day 5 -> stop

rescue.change: Drop the store: become a TikTok Shop affiliate creator in one pet niche, earning commission on other brands' products with no ad spend or stock.
rescue.why: Removes CAC (ltv_cac), stock and margin risk (costs_eat_margin); capital near zero.
rescue.effort: 3-6 months of 2 videos/day to build a following
rescue.requires: On-camera content habit; follower minimum for affiliate access (check TikTok's current threshold)

rescue.change: Sell one US-stocked hero bundle at $45+ on TikTok Shop, paid to creators only per sale via affiliate commission, not upfront ads.
rescue.why: Turns CAC into a per-sale commission (no_distribution, ltv_cac); higher AOV lifts contribution.
rescue.effort: 4-8 weeks incl. sourcing and creator outreach
rescue.requires: Supplier MOQ within budget; 20+ creator samples sent
